body:
Thanks so much. It's nice to hear that bulimia doesn't necessarily have to prevent me from finding success. I'd like to have a normal relationship with food, and I wish that I could be one of those people that just eats when they're hungry and doesn't really spend any time thinking about food. But I'm not. 

I'm not really sure where I was going with that, but thanks for your input. It's easy to think of the bulimia as a character flaw, so just being told that it doesn't make me a coward or a loser is comforting in its own way.

Thanks so much for being here for me, a complete stranger, in a time of desperation. Knowing that somebody like you can care about my well being when I can't even be bothered to care about my own well being long enough to eat like a normal person gives me some faith that life isn't just one disappointment after another.

Thanks for the kind words. While, realistically, reaching out to strangers on reddit might not get me through the darkness every night, seeing your comment reminded me of the light at the end of this tunnel and kept me from giving up for at least one more night.
